name: Land of Infinite Dreams
detailed_description:
Land of Infinite Dreams is a story-driven, single-player action-adventure that takes players on an emotional journey through surreal dreamscapes — as Princess Luna, a young girl who escapes into Lunaria, a dreamworld shaped by loss, loneliness, and imagination.

Luna's Story

Luna, the young princess of an unknown kingdom, has always lived between two worlds.
Each full moon, she’d step into a magical painting in her castle — and enter Lunaria, a dreamworld of wonder and beauty untouched by the burdens of reality. It was her secret refuge.

But when she turned ten, everything changed.

Her mother passed away. The king remarried. A cold stepmother arrived. A baby brother was born — and Luna became invisible in her own home. Overlooked, unloved, and fading into silence, she clung to Lunaria — the only place she still mattered.

Then, one night, after a bitter argument with her father, Luna collapsed into bed, her heart shattered. As moonlight filled the room, a voice whispered:

“Sleep… and you’ll never have to return. You will live forever in your dreams.”

Key Features

  • A Story-driven Single-player Experience
    Guide Princess Luna through a dreamlike world where every step is tied to emotion and memory. Explore, uncover secrets and shape the story through your choices.

  • Emotionally Powerful Narrative
    Experience a coming-of-age story rooted in grief, imagination, desperation and escapism. Navigate Luna’s inner world as she faces her loss and the temptation to abandon reality.

  • Stylized, Dream-inspired Visuals
    Journey through painterly 3D environments that shift and evolve with Luna’s emotions — from gentle wonder to eerie mystery.

  • Control the Moonlight to Shift Shadows and Illuminate the World
    Use Luna’s power to change the Moon’s position in the sky, dynamically altering global lighting and shadows. Reveal hidden paths, solve light-based puzzles, or simply reshape the mood of the dreamworld.

  • Dialogue Choices That Shape the Dream and Luna’s Emotional State
    Interact with the imaginary inhabitants of Lunaria. Your dialogue choices don’t just influence the story — they also affect Luna’s Desperation Meter. Some responses may calm her, while others drive her closer to emotional collapse, unlocking hidden paths and unexpected consequences.

  • Light Dreamworld Combat
    Engage in light combat against mysterious and terrifying dream-creatures — manifestations of Luna’s fears — using magical moonballs filled with moonlight energy and spells fueled by her emotions. 

  • Varied and Meaningful Puzzles
    Solve environmental and logic-based puzzles woven into the narrative. Each puzzle represents a piece of Luna’s fractured memories or emotions.

  • An Original, Evolving Soundtrack
    Immerse yourself in a rich, emotional score that grows and shifts as Luna’s journey unfolds — from comfort to chaos, hope to healing.
